name: @example/supabase-edge-mcp
description: SolvaPay MCP server on Supabase Edge Functions — `createSolvaPayMcpFetch` over Deno. Ships the paywalled Oracle demo tools plus the SolvaPay intent/UI transport surface.

scripts.build: cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build && cp dist/mcp-app.html supabase/functions/mcp/mcp-app.html
scripts.validate: pnpm -w build:packages && pnpm build && rm -rf supabase/functions/mcp/node_modules && rm -f supabase/functions/mcp/deno.lock ../../../deno.lock && deno check --reload --config=supabase/functions/mcp/deno.local.json supabase/functions/mcp/index.ts
scripts.validate:workspace: pnpm -w build:packages && pnpm build && rm -rf supabase/functions/mcp/node_modules && rm -f deno.lock supabase/functions/mcp/deno.lock ../../../deno.lock && deno check --config=deno.workspace.json supabase/functions/mcp/index.ts
scripts.predeploy: rm -rf supabase/functions/mcp/node_modules && rm -f supabase/functions/mcp/deno.lock && deno cache --reload --config=supabase/functions/mcp/deno.json supabase/functions/mcp/index.ts
